candidates.change_summary: Delete the require that msg.value equals 10 ether, allowing fallback to succeed with no ether sent.
Delete the require that block.timestamp is greater than pastBlockTime, allowing fallback to succeed in the same block.
Change condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, inverting the block at which balance is transferred.
Delete the if-statement entirely, so balance is never transferred in fallback.
Replace msg.value == 10 ether with msg.value == 0, so fallback only accepts 0 ether calls.
Replace transfer of address(this).balance with a fixed 1 ether transfer, changing the amount sent.
Replace pastBlockTime = block.timestamp with pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1, changing the time constraint.
Delete the update to pastBlockTime, so the time constraint check never advances.
Add require(msg.sender != address(0)) at the beginning, restricting EOA calls only.
